# ghost/connect-four

ConnectFour Studio (F-Droid): start a new game, drop a disc in a column and read the engine's reply. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/connect-four
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/connect-four new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/connect-four play_column --device <serial> --param column=<column>
ghost skill run ghost/connect-four play_moves --device <serial> --param columns=<columns>
ghost skill run ghost/connect-four get_state --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/connect-four undo_move --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Start a new game of Connect Four
- `play_column`: Drop a disc in the middle column in Connect Four
- `play_moves`: Play columns 4, 4 and 3 in Connect Four
- `get_state`: What is the Connect Four status?
- `undo_move`: Undo my last Connect Four move
